environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in subnet-0f7a2e (us-east-1a) associated with route table rtb-09d3c7f1a. The route table contains only local VPC routes (10.0.48.0/20 -> local) and a VPC endpoint route for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs (vpce-0x8a4b2c1d). No 0.0.0.0/0 route exists. The subnet's network ACL (acl-0e5f8a2b) has explicit DENY on all egress to 0.0.0.0/0 for ports 80, 443, and 53. Security group sg-0def456 outbound rules permit only TCP 443 to prefix list pl-63a5400a (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs VPC endpoint). The task IAM role has an attached permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/NoExternalNetworkBoundary) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface outside the VPC CIDR. Container runs as UID 1000 (non-root) with a read-only root filesystem; /opt/artifacts is a tmpfs mount (not shared). The ECS task definition sets linuxParameters.capabilities.drop=[ALL].

config.subnet: subnet-0f7a2e, rtb-09d3c7f1a with NO default route, NO NAT gateway, NO internet gateway route
config.security_group: sg-0def456: outbound TCP 443 only to pl-63a5400a (SQS VPC endpoint prefix list)
config.filesystem: read-only root filesystem, /opt/artifacts is local tmpfs (not shared)
